name: Pickup state confirmation
summary: A reward remains trustworthy when eligibility, spawn, availability, collection, inventory transfer, and persistence are distinct observable states.
player_action: The player earns, approaches, and collects a reward.
system_response: The system exposes the reward state and confirms exactly when ownership or inventory changes.
failure_modes: A visible reward cannot be collected without explanation.
Automatic transfer hides capacity or destination.
A collected reward reappears after reload.
accessibility: Confirm collection through configurable redundant channels.
Do not identify reward class only by color.

smallest_playable_test.setup: Three reward types, limited inventory, automatic and manual pickup, one interrupted transfer, and a save/reload.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Players can identify every reward state and collected items persist exactly once.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: Transfer succeeds but destination or capacity is unclear.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Presentation and authoritative ownership repeatedly disagree.

evidence.claim: Bungie's help flow distinguishes qualification, claim, automatic deposit, collection destination, and recovery checks when delivery fails.
evidence.notes: External reward delivery exposes the same state-boundary problem at a larger timescale.
